name: Bursting the door
description: A worked Might test — Orden shoulders through a barred iron door.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: The iron door is barred — and the chanting is getting faster.

lines.speaker: ORDEN
lines.text: I hit it shoulder-first. Might test!

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: The bar splinters — you're through, but ~~the noise carries~~.

name: The grapple
description: A worked Might resistance — Kaelen shrugs off a cultist's grab.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: The cultist lunges to grab you off the ledge.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: He bounces off — ~~prone~~ at your boots.

name: Kaelen swings
description: The Power Roll in action — Kaelen's Brutal Slam lands a tier 3.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: The bugbear rounds on you, Kaelen — roll it.

lines.speaker: KAELEN
lines.text: Brutal Slam — that's a **Might** ability. Rolling…

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: Tier 3: ~~7 damage~~ and a push into the brazier.

name: Into the lair
description: The Lich's Lair, part 1 — a stealth montage into the barrow.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: The barrow mouth breathes cold. Getting in unseen is a {@action montage-test|montage}.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: I read the ward-glyphs — Reason test.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: The wards part like curtains — ~~one success~~.

lines.speaker: ORDEN
lines.text: I try to keep pace at the rear — but I clip a loose stone.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: ~~A scrape, a curse~~ — one failure, but the party's already inside.

name: Minion skirmish
description: The Lich's Lair, part 2 — a minion squad and its captain, sample script.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: Four cultists spill from the side passage — a {@combat minion|minion} squad, their adept close behind.

lines.speaker: KAELEN
lines.text: Two are in reach — Brutal Slam!

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: ~~Two cultists drop~~ — the squad's shared pool is thin now.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: The last two rush Kaelen while their {@combat captain|adept} barks them on.

lines.speaker: KAELEN
lines.text: Finish it — free strike as they close!

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: ~~The squad falls~~ — the adept alone now, and thinking better of it.

name: The lich fight
description: The Lich's Lair, part 3 — a solo boss spending Malice, sample script.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: The lich rises from its throne, {@resource malice|Malice} already crackling at its fingers.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: I hit it with a Reason blast before it can act!

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: It spends 3 Malice for an extra action — and curses the party.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: ~~Sera staggers~~ under the curse — but the lich is running low on Malice.

name: Aftermath
description: The Lich's Lair, part 4 — victories tallied, then a respite, sample script.

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: The lich's crown clatters to the floor. The lair falls silent.

lines.speaker: ORDEN
lines.text: That's one for the tally — Victory test?

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: One {@resource victories|Victory}, banked. ~~Back to town for a respite~~ — Recoveries and Stamina reset, Victories become Experience.
